description: This file is a C++ source file implementing network information handling, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems. It contains classes and functions for network interface enumeration, address modification, route management, and network status updates, with detailed platform-specific implementations.
external_files: <windows-specific headers like iphlpapi.h, ws2ipdef.h, etc. on Windows>
<POSIX-specific headers like arpa/inet.h, ifaddrs.h, rtnetlink.h, etc. on POSIX systems>

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Represents a network interface, providing methods to check status, enable/disable, set gateway, and update interface properties.

classes.name: AdapterIterator
classes.description: Iterates over network adapters, providing access to MAC address, name, and index.

classes.name: IPNode
classes.description: Represents an IP address node with host address and mask.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Identifier for network nodes, supporting IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

classes.name: RoutingTable
classes.description: Represents the system's routing table, allowing retrieval of routes.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a network route with destination, gateway, interface, and other attributes.

classes.name: IPNetworks
classes.description: Singleton class managing network interfaces and addresses, with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows.

classes.name: AdapterObserver
classes.description: Observer class for network adapter events, allowing registration and notification of network changes.

methods.name: ConvertMACToString
methods.description: Converts a MAC address byte array to a string representation with delimiters.

methods.name: LoadAdapterInfo
methods.description: Loads network adapter information on Windows using GetAdaptersAddresses.

methods.name: Address
methods.description: Returns the IP address at a specific index for an adapter.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an IP address to the adapter.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes an IP address from the adapter.

methods.name: Gateway
methods.description: Sets a gateway for a network.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates network interface properties based on netlink messages.

methods.name: RequestStatus
methods.description: Requests network interface status updates via netlink.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the netlink socket for communication.
